title: Existence of the signed quotient isomorphism map
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sp-cone-horizontal-quotient-iso, for each p and n there exists a map from the graded quotient object to the shifted column cone which is an isomorphism and whose composite with the quotient projection equals the signed horizontal projection.

source.place: First-filtration graded object column projection calculation.

proof.text: Apply the kernel equality for the restricted signed projection g and the next-tail inclusion i. Since image(i)=ker(g), i factors through that kernel and i followed by g is zero. Form the short complex (i,g), and use ShortComplex.exact_iff_image_eq_kernel to prove exactness.
The explicit column-inclusion construction proves g is epic. Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.gIsCokernel then supplies the cokernel universal property of g.

The graded piece is the cokernel of the next-tail subcomplex inclusion. Evaluation in degree n preserves this cokernel, by CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit applied to cokernelIsCokernel and HomologicalComplex.eval.

Use IsColimit.coconePointUniqueUpToIso to compare the evaluated graded cokernel with gIsCokernel. Its hom is an isomorphism. The component equation comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom at WalkingParallelPair.one proves exactly the prescribed quotient-projection equation.

proof_origin.place: V1: exactness and epimorphic projection imply cokernel, followed by evaluation and uniqueness of cokernels.

from.place: Existence portion of the quotient isomorphism proof.

lean.statement:
theorem coneHorizontal_quotient_iso_exists
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n = coneHorizontalStep f p n)
    (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ a : (F.gradedPiece (p : ℤ)).X n ⟶
      ((CochainComplex.mappingCone
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (f.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))⟦-(p : ℤ)⟧).X n,
      IsIso a ∧
        (F.complexQuotientπ (p : ℤ) ((p : ℤ) + 1) (by omega)).f n ≫ a =
          (F.step (p : ℤ)).arrow.f n ≫ coneHorizontalProjection f p n
